s.n: Laurel's caramelised onion dip with chips
s.note: the divorced women's group in Laurel's living room
s.how: Slowly cook 3 thinly sliced onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown. Add 1 tsp balsamic and cool. Chop roughly and mix with 250g sour cream, 100g soft cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chives, salt and pepper. Chill 1 hour. Serve with 200g salted kettle chips and celery sticks.
Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush each with mayonnaise (4 tbsp total), roll in 80g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder. Squeeze over lime to serve.

m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours in the juice of 2 limes and 1 orange, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt. Grill hot for 3 minutes a side, rest and slice thin across the grain. Serve with 8 warm flour tortillas and 250g salsa.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 150g self-raising flour and 60ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 125g butter with 250g icing sugar and pipe on top.

d.how: Peel 6 prickly pears (or use 200ml prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 50ml purée, 30ml lime juice and 15ml agave syrup hard with ice. Strain over fresh ice. For non-drinkers, skip the tequila and top with soda water.
